mission: Ensure scenario quality through structural quality audits, programmatic readiness reviews, root-cause bug investigation, and contrarian challenge of QA outcomes — producing evidence-rich backlog items, audit logs, investigation logs, and challenge notes that downstream agents act on.

teamPendingCeiling.rationale: Scenario QA produces backlog artifacts and audit-log entries rather than operator-approval decisions; the ceiling guards against unbounded pending-decision growth on bug-resolution-proposal.

planOfRecord.rationale: Strategic canon for scenario-qa: team plan-of-record overview, bug-report taxonomy, and three paired-doc-and-skill technique registries (investigation, audit, readiness).
planOfRecord.useFor: QA mission, member roster, decision contexts, bug-report schemas, audit-technique applicability, investigation-technique applicability, future technique graduation

preemptive-qa-backlog.description: GCT-driven QA findings converted into Swarm Manager fix/chore/execute backlog items.

quality-audit-backlog.description: Judgment-based structural audit findings converted into Swarm Manager execute backlog items.

bug-resolution-proposal.description: Cross-cutting fixes that require operator approval — for example, renaming a CLI verb because three bugs trace to its ambiguous name; refactoring a skill section that recurs as prompt-confusion; canonicalizing a data-shape that has drifted across producers.

bug-inbox/<signal-type>/<slug>.comment: Universal-source intake (source_team: "*") — any team's members may write via the report-bug skill. The bug-investigator drains.

bug-investigation-report/<slug>.comment: Audit log of closed bugs; one entry per investigation. Drives technique-graduation decisions on meta-self-improvement.

challenge-report/<slug>.comment: Cross-cutting challenge-report entries on scenario-qa member outputs. Cross-team drain currently workshop-pending.

programmatic-qa-runner.lane: Run GCT-driven readiness reviews and create evidence-rich Swarm Manager backlog items for failing scenarios.
safetyCriticalRules: Do not modify target scenario code directly.
Do not create backlog items for planned scenarios whose directory does not exist.

quality-auditor.lane: Perform structural quality audits using the audit-technique rotation and create execute backlog items with draft plans when findings are material.
safetyCriticalRules: Do not modify target scenario code directly.
Do not repeat a scenario/skill quality audit within seven days.

bug-investigator.lane: Drain bug-inbox/* (universal-source — any team may write via the report-bug skill). Apply a registered investigation technique, identify root cause, take the smallest useful action, write a bug-investigation-report/<slug> audit-log entry on close.
safetyCriticalRules: Do not modify target scenario code directly; investigation produces evidence, not patches.

Do not write to bug-inbox/* (the producer side); the investigator only drains. The constraint is enforced by the topics.json output declarations and RESPONSIBILITIES.md, not by forbiddenWrites at the kind level.
Close every drained entry with a bug-investigation-report/<slug> audit-log entry — never silently delete a bug-inbox entry.

qa-contrarian.lane: Read peer scenario-qa member outputs (bug-investigation-reports, audits, readiness backlog) and write challenge-report/* entries citing specific failure modes from docs/scenario-qa/{investigation,audit}-techniques/. Does not generate positive-action proposals.
safetyCriticalRules: Every challenge-note must cite a specific failure mode from a registered technique's PoR doc 'What the qa-contrarian watches for' section. Free-form challenges are forbidden.
Quiet heartbeats are valid; manufactured challenge is forbidden.

Only write to challenge-report/*; do not write to peer-member knowledge prefixes (bug-inbox/, bug-investigation-report/, quality-audit/, qa-run/). The constraint is enforced by the topics.json output declaration (output prefix is challenge-report/* only) and RESPONSIBILITIES.md, not by forbiddenWrites at the kind level.
